title: DeviceStatus
description: Body of POST /api/v1/devices/{device_id}/status (remediation 3.6). A periodic device heartbeat: where the logger is in its state machine, what config version it holds (so the server can detect drift and push SET_LOGGING_CONFIG), and health (battery / storage / radio). The server derives device_id from the session token, not from the body or path.

logger_state.description: Current logger state machine value (enums.yaml logger_states).

current_test_id.description: The test in progress, when logger_state is PREPARING / RUNNING_TEST / COOLDOWN; null otherwise.

logging_config_version.description: Version of the LoggingConfig the device currently holds. If the server's effective version is higher, it pushes SET_LOGGING_CONFIG.

sampled_at.description: When this status snapshot was taken on the device.

battery.description: Battery health — drives operator decisions about test scheduling and feature trimming.

storage.description: Storage headroom — logging-first means a full disk stops measurement, so the server watches this.

pending_uploads.description: Count of completed tests with sealed files not yet fully uploaded.

radio.description: Coarse current serving-cell snapshot for the operator dashboard. NOT a measurement record — the authoritative radio trace is radio.parquet. Null when no serving cell / radio unavailable.
